'''''Arundo plinii''''' is a species of herb in the family [[Poaceae]] (true grasses).<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Arundo plinii'' Turra - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/47160908|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Arundo plinii'' (False Reed) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/POAC/Arundo_plinii.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref> It is native to southern Europe, Lebanon and Syria.<ref name=POWO/>
